{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA rows: revenue == 999999.99
total_rows = len(df)
qa_rows = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA rows: {len(qa_rows)}')

# Drop QA rows
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Verify that the data is clean
print(f'Rows after removing QA: {len(df_clean)}')

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
df_loyal_completed = df_clean[(df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df_clean['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = df_loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Output
print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers (excluding QA): {mean_revenue:.2f}')"}
